package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestClientGetsStrictStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Method != http.MethodGet || request.URL.Path != "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/planning-readiness" {
			http.NotFound(writer, request)
			return
		}
		assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-read-token")
		if request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "" {
			t.Error("readiness read must not send an idempotency key")
		}
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"schema":"student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1",
			"student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},
			"learning_intent":{"code":"learn_programming","source":"onboarding_goal_code.v1","provenance":"accepted_student_draft"},
			"profile":{
				"direction_code":"undecided","self_assessed_experience":"beginner",
				"known_stacks":{"state":"answered","values":[]},
				"desired_stacks":{"state":"unanswered"},
				"preferred_language":{"code":"ru","provenance":"explicit_ui"},
				"content_language":{"code":"ru","provenance":"explicit_ui","source":"preferred_language"}
			}
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, ReadToken: "student-read-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	snapshot, err := client.GetPlanningReadiness(context.Background(), studentID)
	if err != nil || snapshot.StateRef.Version != 4 || snapshot.Profile.KnownStacks.Values == nil ||
		len(snapshot.Profile.KnownStacks.Values) != 0 || !snapshot.Profile.KnownStacks.ValuesPresent ||
		snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks.ValuesPresent || snapshot.Profile.ContentLanguage == nil {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot=%#v err=%v", snapshot, err)
	}
}

func TestClientRejectsMalformedStudentPlanningReadinessResponses(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	valid := `{"schema":"student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1","student_id":"` + studentID + `","state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"learning_intent":{"code":"learn_programming","source":"onboarding_goal_code.v1","provenance":"accepted_student_draft"},"profile":{"direction_code":"undecided","self_assessed_experience":"beginner","known_stacks":{"state":"unanswered"},"desired_stacks":{"state":"answered","values":[]},"preferred_language":{"code":"ru","provenance":"explicit_text"},"content_language":{"code":"ru","provenance":"explicit_text","source":"preferred_language"}}}`
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		body string
	}{
		{name: "unknown field", body: strings.TrimSuffix(valid, "}") + `,"profile_copy":{}}`},
		{name: "trailing json", body: valid + `{}`},
		{name: "answered values missing", body: strings.Replace(valid, `"desired_stacks":{"state":"answered","values":[]}`, `"desired_stacks":{"state":"answered"}`, 1)},
		{name: "null optional", body: strings.Replace(valid, `"direction_code":"undecided"`, `"direction_code":null`, 1)},
		{name: "student drift", body: strings.Replace(valid, studentID, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", 1)},
		{name: "oversize", body: valid + strings.Repeat(" ", maximumPlanningReadinessResponseBytes)},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, ReadToken: "student-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			if _, err := client.GetPlanningReadiness(context.Background(), studentID); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected malformed Student response to fail")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientUsesExactStudentPrivateContracts(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	pathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	planningRequestID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	idempotencyKey := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	calls := make(map[string]int)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		calls[request.Method+" "+request.URL.Path]++
		switch request.Method + " " + request.URL.Path {
		case http.MethodGet + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/learner-overview":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-read-token")
			writeStudentJSON(writer, map[string]any{
				"student_id": studentID, "version": learnerOverviewVersion,
				"learning_path": map[string]any{
					"course_id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "goal_code": "go.backend",
					"course_fingerprint": "fingerprint-v1", "version": 3,
				},
				"onboarding": map[string]any{
					"version":        int64(7),
					"direction_code": "backend", "self_assessed_experience": "advanced",
					"known_stacks": []string{"php"}, "desired_stacks": []string{"go"},
					"goal_code": "go.backend", "preferred_language": "ru", "weekly_minutes": 300,
					"preferred_pace": "standard", "profile_version": domain.StudentPlanningProfileVersion,
				},
			})
		case http.MethodPost + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/mastery/query":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-read-token")
			var payload struct {
				Targets []domain.TargetRef `json:"targets"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil || len(payload.Targets) != 1 {
				t.Errorf("unexpected mastery body: targets=%#v err=%v", payload.Targets, err)
			}
			writeStudentJSON(writer, map[string]any{"items": []domain.TargetMastery{{
				Target: payload.Targets[0], State: domain.MasteryUnknown,
				PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion,
			}}})
		case http.MethodPut + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/courses/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/assignment":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-write-token")
			if request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" {
				t.Errorf("unexpected assignment idempotency key")
			}
			var payload struct {
				PlanningRequestID string `json:"planning_request_id"`
				AssignedBy        string `json:"assigned_by"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil ||
				payload.PlanningRequestID != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" ||
				payload.AssignedBy != "learning_planner" {
				t.Errorf("unexpected assignment body: payload=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
			}
			writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
		case http.MethodPut + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/learning-path":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-write-token")
			if request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != idempotencyKey {
				t.Errorf("unexpected create path idempotency key")
			}
			var payload domain.LearningPathReplacement
			if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil ||
				payload.CourseFingerprint != "fingerprint-v2" || payload.PlanningRequestID != planningRequestID ||
				payload.ExpectedVersion != 0 {
				t.Errorf("unexpected learning path body: payload=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
			}
			writeStudentJSON(writer, map[string]any{
				"id": pathID, "student_id": studentID, "course_id": payload.CourseID, "goal_code": payload.GoalCode,
				"course_fingerprint": payload.CourseFingerprint, "version": 1,
			})
		case http.MethodGet + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/learning-paths/" + pathID + "/planning-state":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-write-token")
			writeStudentJSON(writer, studentPlanningState(studentID, pathID, 3))
		case http.MethodPut + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/learning-paths/" + pathID:
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-write-token")
			if request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != idempotencyKey {
				t.Errorf("unexpected replan idempotency key")
			}
			var payload struct {
				domain.LearningPathReplan
				LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil || payload.Schema != domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema ||
				payload.PlanningRequestID != planningRequestID || payload.ExpectedVersion != 3 || payload.LearningPathID != "" {
				t.Errorf("unexpected exact replan body: payload=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
			}
			writeStudentJSON(writer, studentCommandResult("REPLAN", planningRequestID, studentPlanningState(studentID, pathID, 4)))
		case http.MethodPut + " /internal/students/" + studentID + "/learning-paths/" + pathID + "/completion":
			assertStudentToken(t, request, "student-write-token")
			if request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != idempotencyKey {
				t.Errorf("unexpected completion idempotency key")
			}
			var payload struct {
				domain.LearningPathCompletion
				LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil || payload.ExpectedVersion != 3 ||
				payload.CourseFingerprint != "fingerprint-v1" || payload.Schema != domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema ||
				payload.PlanningRequestID != planningRequestID || payload.LearningPathID != "" {
				t.Errorf("unexpected learning path completion body: payload=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
			}
			state := studentPlanningState(studentID, pathID, 4)
			state["status"] = "COMPLETED"
			state["is_selected"] = false
			state["items"].([]map[string]any)[0]["status"] = "SKIPPED_MASTERED"
			writeStudentJSON(writer, studentCommandResult("NO_GAP", planningRequestID, state))
		default:
			http.NotFound(writer, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, ReadToken: "student-read-token", WriteToken: "student-write-token",
		HTTPClient: server.Client(),
	}

	profile, err := client.GetPlanningProfile(context.Background(), studentID)
	if err != nil || profile.GoalCode != "go.backend" || profile.LearningPathGoalCode != "go.backend" ||
		profile.LearningPathRevision != "fingerprint-v1" ||
		profile.LearningPathVersion != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("get profile: profile=%#v err=%v", profile, err)
	}
	target := domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	mastery, err := client.QueryMastery(context.Background(), studentID, []domain.TargetRef{target})
	if err != nil || len(mastery) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("query mastery: mastery=%#v err=%v", mastery, err)
	}
	if err := client.AssignCourse(
		context.Background(), studentID, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("assign course: %v", err)
	}
	allocation, err := client.CreateLearningPath(context.Background(), studentID, idempotencyKey, domain.LearningPathReplacement{
		PlanningRequestID: planningRequestID,
		CourseID:          "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v2", PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Build a Go API", ExpectedVersion: 0,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{target}, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	})
	if err != nil || allocation.LearningPathID != pathID {
		t.Fatalf("replace learning path: %v", err)
	}
	state, err := client.GetLearningPathPlanningState(context.Background(), studentID, pathID)
	if err != nil || state.PathVersion != 3 || state.LearningPathID != pathID {
		t.Fatalf("get exact planning state: state=%#v err=%v", state, err)
	}
	replanResult, err := client.ReplanLearningPath(context.Background(), studentID, idempotencyKey, domain.LearningPathReplan{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: pathID, PlanningRequestID: planningRequestID,
		CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "mastery_replan", ReasonSummary: "Refresh", ExpectedVersion: 3,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{target}, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	})
	if err != nil || replanResult.Command != "REPLAN" || replanResult.State.LearningPathID != pathID {
		t.Fatalf("replan exact path: result=%#v err=%v", replanResult, err)
	}
	completionResult, err := client.CompleteLearningPath(context.Background(), studentID, idempotencyKey, domain.LearningPathCompletion{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema, LearningPathID: pathID, PlanningRequestID: planningRequestID,
		CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap", ReasonSummary: "All required targets are mastered", ExpectedVersion: 3,
	})
	if err != nil || completionResult.Command != "NO_GAP" || completionResult.State.Status != "COMPLETED" {
		t.Fatalf("complete learning path: %v", err)
	}
	if len(calls) != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected calls: %#v", calls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticClientUsesStrictReservationAndAggregateResultWire(t *testing.T) {
	plan := diagnosticClientPlan(t)
	result := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1, StudentID: plan.StudentID, CourseID: plan.CourseID, CourseContentRevision: plan.CourseRevision, PolicyVersion: plan.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: plan.ID, PlanID: plan.ID, PlanRevision: plan.PlanRevision, Correct: 4, Total: 5, Percent: 80, Band: "ADVANCED", BandPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest, CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	result.ResultDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticResultDigest(result)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "planner-only" {
			t.Errorf("token=%q", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/internal/v1/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + plan.ID + "/reserve":
			if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != plan.ID || r.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
				t.Errorf("reserve request=%s key=%q content=%q", r.Method, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
			}
			var got domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
			dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
			dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
			if dec.Decode(&got) != nil || dec.Decode(&struct{}{}) == nil || domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(got) != nil {
				t.Error("plan body was not exact")
			}
			writeStudentJSON(w, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationSchemaV1, ID: plan.ID, PlanID: plan.ID, PlanRevision: plan.PlanRevision, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest})
		case "/internal/v1/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + plan.ID + "/result":
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet || r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "" {
				t.Error("result request headers")
			}
			writeStudentJSON(w, result)
		default:
			http.NotFound(w, r)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, ReadToken: "general", WriteToken: "planner-only", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if receipt, err := client.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Background(), plan.StudentID, plan); err != nil || receipt.ID != plan.ID {
		t.Fatalf("reserve receipt=%#v err=%v", receipt, err)
	}
	if got, err := client.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(context.Background(), plan.StudentID, plan.ID); err != nil || got.ResultDigest != result.ResultDigest {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticClientRejectsRedirectAndMalformedResult(t *testing.T) {
	plan := diagnosticClientPlan(t)
	targetCalls := 0
	target := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		targetCalls++
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			t.Error("redirect leaked token")
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer target.Close()
	redirect := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { http.Redirect(w, r, target.URL, http.StatusFound) }))
	defer redirect.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: redirect.URL, WriteToken: "secret", HTTPClient: redirect.Client()}
	if _, err := client.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Background(), plan.StudentID, plan); err == nil || targetCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("redirect err=%v calls=%d", err, targetCalls)
	}
	bad := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1","unexpected":true}`))
	}))
	defer bad.Close()
	client = Client{BaseURL: bad.URL, WriteToken: "secret", HTTPClient: bad.Client()}
	if _, err := client.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(context.Background(), plan.StudentID, plan.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid) {
		t.Fatalf("malformed err=%v", err)
	}
}

func diagnosticClientPlan(t *testing.T) domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	t.Helper()
	p := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", CourseRevision: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	for n := 0; n < 3; n++ {
		p.Assessments = append(p.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessment{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-44444444444" + string(rune('0'+n)), TaskID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555555" + string(rune('0'+n)), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: n})
	}
	p.PlanDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticPlanDigest(p)
	return p
}

func TestClientRejectsCrossPathPlanningState(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	requestedPathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	otherPathID := "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/learning-paths/"+requestedPathID+"/planning-state" {
			http.NotFound(writer, request)
			return
		}
		writeStudentJSON(writer, studentPlanningState(studentID, otherPathID, 3))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if _, err := client.GetLearningPathPlanningState(context.Background(), studentID, requestedPathID); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("cross-path response error=%v, want validation error", err)
	}
}

func TestClientPreservesDeliveredExactPathConflict(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	pathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	planningRequestID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		http.Error(writer, "stale path version", http.StatusConflict)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.ReplanLearningPath(context.Background(), studentID, planningRequestID, domain.LearningPathReplan{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: pathID, PlanningRequestID: planningRequestID,
		CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "mastery_replan", ReasonSummary: "Refresh", ExpectedVersion: 3,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{}, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("delivered Student 409 was not preserved: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestClientMapsOnlyExactDiagnosticContextConflictAndSendsFence(t *testing.T) {
	for _, body := range []string{"diagnostic_context_stale", "stale path version"} {
		t.Run(body, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				var command domain.LearningPathReplacement
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&command) != nil || command.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 7 || command.ExpectedDirectionCode != "backend" {
					t.Error("missing frozen diagnostic fence")
				}
				http.Error(w, body, http.StatusConflict)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.CreateLearningPath(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", domain.LearningPathReplacement{PlanningRequestID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", ExpectedOnboardingVersion: 7, ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend", Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{}}})
			want := domain.ErrConflict
			if body == "diagnostic_context_stale" {
				want = domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale
			}
			if !errors.Is(err, want) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v want=%v", err, want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func studentPlanningState(studentID, pathID string, pathVersion int64) map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"schema": domain.LearningPathPlanningStateSchema, "student_id": studentID, "learning_path_id": pathID,
		"course_id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "goal_code": "go.backend",
		"course_fingerprint": "fingerprint-v1", "status": "ACTIVE", "is_primary": false, "is_selected": true,
		"path_version": pathVersion, "journey_version": 9, "planner_policy_version": "course-planner-v1",
		"reason_code": "initial_plan", "reason_summary": "Build a Go API", "updated_at": "2026-09-04T10:00:00Z",
		"items": []map[string]any{{
			"reference_type": "lesson", "reference_id": "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", "position": 0,
			"status": "READY", "targets": []map[string]any{{"type": "concept", "key": "go.syntax", "version": "v1"}},
			"reason_code": "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}
}

func studentCommandResult(command, planningRequestID string, state map[string]any) map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"schema": domain.LearningPathCommandResultSchema, "planning_request_id": planningRequestID,
		"command": command, "changed": true, "state": state,
	}
}

func TestClientRejectsUnknownOverviewVersion(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writeStudentJSON(writer, map[string]any{
			"student_id": studentID, "version": "unknown-v9", "onboarding": map[string]any{},
		})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, ReadToken: "student-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if _, err := client.GetPlanningProfile(context.Background(), studentID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unknown overview version to fail")
	}
}

func assertStudentToken(t *testing.T, request *http.Request, expected string) {
	t.Helper()
	if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != expected {
		t.Errorf("internal token = %q, want %q", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"), expected)
	}
}

func writeStudentJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
